svg.title: 1212 Lobdel Avenue — Yield Option Site Plans, All Four Scenarios
svg.desc: Four accurate-proportion 2D site plans for 1212 Lobdel Avenue showing Scenario I (36 units, 18ft wide), Scenario II (40 units, 16ft wide), Scenario III (24 units, 20ft wide), and Scenario D (36 units, garage-base/garden roof). Each plan is drawn to the same scale with dimensions labeled.
